description: This file implements the VaultNetflix class, providing methods for managing cryptographic keys, including loading, exporting, importing, deleting, and retrieving key information, as well as obtaining the ESN. It interacts with external cryptographic libraries and system info components.

classes.name: VaultNetflix
classes.description: A singleton class managing Netflix-specific cryptographic keys and ESN, providing methods for key management and retrieval.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::NetflixInstance
methods.description: Creates or returns a singleton instance of VaultNetflix, initializing it with environment-based key loading.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::loadBoundKeys
methods.description: Loads bound keys from input data into the vault, updating internal state.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::esn
methods.description: Retrieves the ESN string, caching it after first retrieval.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::namedKeys
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the map of named keys (DKE, DKH, DKW).

methods.name: VaultNetflix::GetNamedKey
methods.description: Fetches a named key handle from the external library and stores it in internal maps.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::AddKey
methods.description: Adds a key handle to the internal map and returns its assigned ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::GetNewKeyHandle
methods.description: Finds the next available key handle ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key by handle from the external library and internal map.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::FindKey
methods.description: Finds a key handle in the internal map by ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::FindNamedKey
methods.description: Finds a named key ID in the internal map by name.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::DeleteKeyFromMap
methods.description: Removes a key handle from the internal map.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::getKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a key, such as type, algorithm, and usage.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of a key, exporting it if applicable.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Import
methods.description: Stores a DH public key for future cryptographic operations.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Export
methods.description: Exports a public key to a buffer.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Put
methods.description: Stores a sealed key blob and returns its handle ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a sealed key blob by handle ID.

methods.name: VaultNetflix::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key by handle ID, with special handling for encryption key.
